intent: Improve combined ON/OFF PID and native adjustable fans with user-measured per-stage/per-speed relative physical capacity, calibrated independently per exact HVAC direction and controller. Compensate ON duty by actual fan stage capacity while keeping quiet limits and reporting unmet demand. Legacy b40 allocation remains default until explicitly calibrated.
note: Never assume Low/Medium/High fractions, extrapolate below measured fan speeds, infer heating/moisture output from RPM, or automatically exercise hardware. Explicit Apply on native physically OFF, no pending power/ack, exact source-mode identity. Hardware timing/window/ownership unchanged.
changes: Pure measured fan capacity model for two-to-five genuinely ordered discrete native speeds, with complete user measured relative capacities and top native stage normalized to 100% output reference.

Support generic native percentage fan speeds using at least two explicitly measured speed-to-delivered-capacity pairs plus full-speed reference; interpolate only inside observed range and only use actual native percentage steps.
Save calibration per exact physical primary, exact fan entity, advertised native fan list, and heat/cool/dry mode; reject stale source or wrong mode automatically.
Add per-device measured-capacity strategy (Legacy default/Measured), native HVAC calibration direction, bounded numeric capacity measurements, and explicit physically-OFF Apply button.
Convert one PID output request to calibrated fan selection and compensated duty, saturating duty under quiet cap and exposing predicted output and unmet demand in diagnostics and dashboard.
Keep quiet when sleeping/occupied as fan-speed cap and independent compressor/power safety; do not invent stage capacity or turn accessory fans on.
Keep prior PID gains and calibration methods, manual settings, source permissions, min ON/OFF, max ON, defrost, valid feedback, recovery/acknowledgement, and canonical environment_manager unchanged.
Include reproducible pure numeric and integration tests, exact-room frontend edits, HA 2026.10 checks, Python 3.13/3.14, HACS/Hassfest, 38 locale catalog and immutable flat beta package.
